operations.name: read_mac
operations.desc: Read MAC address from e1000 NIC
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov ebx, 0xfebc0000
mov eax, [ebx + 0x5400]
ret

operations.name: read_status
operations.desc: Read link status of e1000 NIC
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov ebx, 0xfebc0000
mov eax, [ebx + 0x0008]
ret
operations.returns: Status register in EAX (bit 1 = link up)
